Stage 1 — The Lobby

At 09:14 this morning, Mittens Fluffington III — a 3-year-old tabby belonging to the Head of Security — walked across the emergency admin terminal and triggered the VAULT-9 lockdown sequence.

The VAULT-9 encoder generates lock codes from three secret seed values using a proprietary algorithm. Mittens corrupted the seed file before the system could save it — but the codes had already been output. Recover the seeds.

The VAULT-9 encoder algorithm:

KEYLOG = "fjk39dls02pqzxcv8nm1"

for i in {0, 1, 2}:
    acc = SEED[i]
    for each character ch at position j in KEYLOG:
        acc = (acc × 31 + ord(ch) + i × 17) mod 65536
    CODE[i] = (acc mod 9000) + 1000

The system output these lock codes before the seed file was lost:

CODE ALPHA7790
CODE BETA2244
CODE GAMMA9873

The VAULT-9 seed register stores 4-digit integers.
